name: Restrict
short: Restrict users, channels, or roles from sending GIFs, media, links, stickers, and more.
description: Comprehensive moderation restriction system for Red-DiscordBot. Restrict specific users from posting GIFs (Tenor, Giphy, direct URLs, attachments, embeds) or other media types with instant, silent auto-deletion, customizable notifications, temporary durations, mod-logging, and spam escalation safeguards.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user, channel, and role IDs solely for enforcing active moderation restrictions configured by server administrators.
install_msg:
Thanks for installing Restrict!

To restrict a user from sending GIFs silently: `[p]restrict gif user @user` (or simply `[p]restrict gif @user`).
To view active restrictions: `[p]restrict list`.
To view configuration options: `[p]restrict set show`.

Default notification mode is **silent** (instant stealth deletion).
